name: Repair desk with observed arrivals
description: An illustrative continuous-time FCFS repair queue. Replay supplied arrival and service times exactly; they are not fitted or independently validated. A manager chooses staffing each minute. Service is non-preemptive: reducing staffing lets existing repairs finish. No breaks, skill differences, setup time or abandonment are modeled. Arrivals at the closing time are outside the observation window; completions at closing count. Changing staffing assumes supplied service requirements remain unchanged.

brief.situation: Manage a repair desk while jobs arrive.
brief.rules: Each minute choose 0 to {$inputs.max_technicians} technicians. Waiting jobs start first come, first served; ongoing repairs finish even if you reduce staffing. Balance waiting and unfinished work against staffing cost. You see current aggregate queue outcomes, not the future arrival table.

roles.manager: Choose staffing to reduce waiting and unfinished work while controlling cost.

jobs.description: Observed or authored times in minutes from opening. Replace this illustrative data with documented operational observations.

staff.description: Choose on-duty staffing for the next minute. Existing service is not interrupted.

status.show: {$world.q_totals.offered} arrivals so far; {$world.q_totals.waiting} waiting. Accrued busy time: {$world.q_totals.busy} minutes. Staffing cost: {$world.q_totals.cost|money}.

completed_jobs.description: Jobs observed completing by closing; no retries in this room.
completed_jobs.label: Completed repairs

unfinished_arrived_jobs.description: Arrived jobs not complete at closing, including in-service work; excludes future arrivals.
unfinished_arrived_jobs.label: Unfinished arrived jobs
